Subject: Model variant consolidation: ops asks and customer comm plan

Team —

Following yesterday's product review, we need to put a concise operational ask together for consolidating our model variants across the text-gen family (v2/v2a/v2-light -> single v2.1) and the customer communication plan for the handful of impacted accounts (pilot group: Acme Health, Betacorp, and two smaller PLG apps). High level objectives:

- Avoid a sharp customer-facing outage or quality regression.
- Provide deterministic migration lanes with clear rollback points.
- Limit support overhead with templated comms and a one-pager for SRE/CS.

Actions I'd like to capture today:
1) Ben: ops readiness checklist (GPU capacity, routing fallback, canary scope) + target cut window options.
2) Marissa: exception criteria and quick-reference rollback criteria (safety & perf).
3) Karthik: SDK/SDK-deprecation notes, breaking-change checklist, and a short Prometheus/trace snippet we can include in the comms.
4) Laura: customer comm drafts & outreach schedule (Acme is highest priority).

I've attached a variant map (variant-map-v2.xlsx) and an initial comm draft for Acme (comm-draft-acme.md) — both rough. Please reply with concise answers inline so I can assemble a one-page ops packet for the exec call tomorrow.

Thanks —
Priya
Priya Natarajan
Director, Product Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: variant-map-v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), comm-draft-acme.md (text)

Thanks, Priya — quick answers inline.

- Ops readiness checklist (short):
  * Capacity: reserve an extra 20% for canary phase (we can use dedicated pool).
  * Routing fallback: implement model alias fallback to v2-light in region us-west.
  * Canary scope: 2% of traffic for 48 hours, then 10% for 24 hours if stable.
  * Monitoring: token latency p50/p95, error rate, generation quality probes (sanity prompts).

- Target cut windows (options):
  A) 2-week rolling: low risk, longer comms cadence.
  B) 72-hour accelerated: for customers who opt in (Acme may want this).

I added a short runbook snippet into variant-map-v2.xlsx (tab: ops-checklist).

Ben
Ben Carter
VP, Infrastructure

Priya — adding exception and rollback notes:

- Exception criteria (short):
  * If generation quality drop > 5% on core eval set for a customer.
  * If per-token latency increases > 25% p95 for two consecutive windows.
  * If error rate spikes > 3% (500/4xx).

- Rollback triggers:
  * Automatic: sustained perf failure > 10 minutes with no improvement after mitigation steps.
  * Manual: customer requests within the cut window + CS endorsement.

I'll attach a one-page decision flow to the ops packet; Ben, please confirm the monitoring hooks are exposed to the canary group (prom/trace links).

Marissa
Sr. Product Manager, Reliability
